title: Coleus Wizard Jade - 1x Mini Plug Plants - Green/White Easy Care Houseplant
description:
This variety is prized for its low-maintenance nature and compact, upright growth habit. It features heart-shaped leaves with distinct ivory-white centres surrounded by broad, vibrant green margins.
Key Features:
Variety: Wizard Jade

Foliage: Bicolour (Creamy white interior with bright green edges).

Habit: Compact and basal-branching (does not require pinching).

Use: Excellent for patio containers, hanging baskets, or bright borders in garden beds. Also thrives as an indoor houseplant or conservatory plant.

Plant Details:
Mature Height: 25–30 cm

Mature Spread: 25–30 cm

Light Requirements: Partial Shade to Full Shade (tolerant of some morning sun).

Hardiness: Tender Perennial (frost tender); grown as an annual in the UK outdoors, or year-round indoors.

Care Instructions:
Water: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged.

Compost: Rich, free-draining compost.

Temperature: Frost tender. Bring indoors or into a greenhouse if temperatures drop below 10°C.

What You Will Receive:
You are purchasing 1x mini plug plant.

Note: Plant size and appearance may vary slightly due to nature, but a healthy specimen similar to the photos will be selected.
